description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics IIS2DH 3-axis accelerometer driver, specifically handling interrupt triggers and GPIO callbacks within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: iis2dh_enable_drdy
methods.description: Enables or disables the data ready interrupt pin.

methods.name: iis2dh_handle_drdy_int
methods.description: Calls the registered data ready handler if available.

methods.name: iis2dh_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready event, reads data, and re-enables interrupt.

methods.name: iis2dh_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback function to handle interrupt pin changes.

methods.name: iis2dh_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling GPIO interrupts if configured.

methods.name: iis2dh_work_cb
methods.description: Workqueue callback for handling GPIO interrupts if configured.

methods.name: iis2dh_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for the accelerometer.
